issues: 短短语在 17 个槽位里靠左摆，文字行和居中的进度条错位，四条短语都不居中
切换峰值只有换字 + 整行抖动 + text-shadow 色散，读作"字在闪"而不是信号故障
进度条 120×2px 孤零零一根线，看不出四拍，也没有任何状态信息
纯色 #0a0b10 平铺底，没有光源、暗角与颗粒
changes: 短语在固定槽位里左右对称补空格（槽位数不变、不重排），行与进度条同中线
同一个 glitch 浓度 g 再驱动水平撕裂带：g>0.25 时行切三段、中段横移 ±g·11px，带位每 2 帧重掷，和换字/位移/色散同源不打架
进度条加宽到 150、渐变填充带微光，加三根四拍刻度（走过即点亮）和 "STEP n/4 / 百分比" 状态行（32px 字高、tabular-nums），末条落定后状态点转实心发光
暗场柔光 Backdrop + 暗角 + soft-light 颗粒，文字加极淡靛蓝辉光；强调色统一为批次靛蓝 #8f97ff
概率关键帧 [1,0,0,0.1,0,0,1] / KF_LAST、每 2 帧重掷、抖动与色散幅度全部保留
issuesEn: Short phrases sat left-aligned in the 17 fixed slots, so the text never lined up with the centered progress bar
The switch peak was only character swaps, row jitter and a text-shadow split — it read as flickering text, not a signal fault
The progress bar was a lone 120×2px line with no sense of the four beats and no status information
Flat #0a0b10 fill with no light, vignette or grain
changesEn: Phrases are padded symmetrically inside the fixed slots (same slot count, no reflow), so the row shares the bar's center line

The same glitch density g now also drives a horizontal tear: above 0.25 the row splits into three bands and the middle one shifts ±g·11px, re-rolled every 2 frames — same source as swaps/jitter/split so they never fight

Bar widened to 150 with a glowing gradient fill, three beat ticks that light up as they're passed, and a "STEP n/4 / percent" status row (32px, tabular-nums); the status dot fills and glows once the last phrase settles
Dark soft-light Backdrop with vignette and soft-light grain, faint indigo glow on the type; accent unified to the batch indigo #8f97ff
Probability keyframes [1,0,0,0.1,0,0,1] / KF_LAST, the 2-frame re-roll and jitter/split amplitudes all kept
